title: Input group 23
description: Search input group with loader and voice button

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import LoaderCircle from '@lucide/svelte/icons/loader-circle';
  import Mic from '@lucide/svelte/icons/mic';
  import Search from '@lucide/svelte/icons/search';
  import { buttonVariants } from '$lib/components/ui/button';
  import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon, InputGroupInput } from '$lib/components/ui/input-group';
  import {
    Tooltip,
    TooltipPopup,
    TooltipProvider,
    TooltipTrigger
  } from '$lib/components/ui/tooltip';

  let inputValue = $state('');
  let isLoading = $state(false);
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

  $effect(() => {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if (inputValue) {
      isLoading = true;
      timer = setTimeout(() => {
        isLoading = false;
      }, 500);
    } else {
      isLoading = false;
    }
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  });
</script>

<TooltipProvider>
  <InputGroup>
    <InputGroupAddon>
      {#if isLoading}
        <LoaderCircle aria-label="Loading..." class="animate-spin" role="status" />
      {:else}
        <Search aria-hidden="true" />
      {/if}
    </InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupInput
      aria-label="Search"
      bind:value={inputValue}
      placeholder="Search..."
      type="search"
    />
    <InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
      <Tooltip>
        <TooltipTrigger
          aria-label="Voice search"
          class={buttonVariants({ size: 'icon-xs', variant: 'ghost' })}
        >
          <Mic aria-hidden="true" />
        </TooltipTrigger>
        <TooltipPopup>Voice search</TooltipPopup>
      </Tooltip>
    </InputGroupAddon>
  </InputGroup>
</TooltipProvider>
